caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden cabinet with a rectangular structure and a solid, paneled front door. The cabinet is shown in three-quarter view, revealing the front and the right side of the object. The wood appears to be a medium brown color with darker grain patterns and some reddish undertones. The door of the cabinet has a recessed central panel and is equipped with metal hardware, including a small handle on the left and two sets of large, decorative black hinges on the right, with each hinge forming a symmetrical, curving design. The top and base of the cabinet are wider than the main body and have beveled edges that extend slightly outward. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color with no additional objects or features.
title: Pa. German Hanging Cupboard
